items.headline: Personalised mRNA vaccine cuts melanoma recurrence or death by 42 percent in phase three trial
items.summary: Intismeran, custom-made for each patient's tumour and given with immunotherapy, reduced the risk of melanoma returning or death by 42 percent at two years in a trial of 1,137 patients.
items.why_it_matters: It is the first individualised cancer vaccine to succeed in a phase three trial, opening a new approach to cancer treatment.

items.headline: India cuts prices of 137 cancer drugs after supreme court calls mark-ups extortion
items.summary: A case brought by a retired bank clerk who could not afford her breast cancer treatment led India's government to cap prices on 137 cancer drugs.
items.why_it_matters: High drug costs push many Indian families into debt or force them to forgo treatment entirely.

items.headline: Australia's Great Koala National Park is created in law
items.summary: New South Wales passed legislation creating a 475,000 hectare national park that is home to about 12,000 koalas, cutting native forest logging in the state by about a fifth.
items.why_it_matters: Koalas are endangered in New South Wales, and habitat loss is the biggest threat to them.
